text:
Maya: Heads up — flooded underpass by 16th & Mission, shuttle can't get through. stuck on 101.
Jae: Same, stuck at Castro. Muni buses rerouted, crowding is wild.
Aaron: I can do a drive-in from SJ, 2 seats available, leaving 8:10. PM me if you want in.
Priya: Yes please Aaron, would take one. Thanks!
commute-bot: Muni alert — 16th St underpass closed due to flooding. Detours in effect. https://status.sfmta.com/alerts
Maya: Also Caltrain is showing ~25m delays this morning.
Aaron: Posted a quick photo of the underpass: http://imgur.com/abc123 (water up to curb)
Front Desk: We have a spare umbrella and an extra pair of socks at the lobby if anyone needs them.
Priya: grabbing the socks now, you're a lifesaver :heart:
Jae: anyone needing a swap for a BART pass? I have a spare Clipper card.
Maya: @Jae can I borrow it for today? Mine's soaked.
Jae: yeah drop by Castro by 8:30 and I'll hand it over.
Aaron: If anyone wants a ride but can't PM — call/text 408-555-0199. Leaving 8:10.
Lola: Heads up parents — SFUSD posted early release for some schools near Mission.
Maya: thanks @Lola saved me a frantic call to daycare :sweat_smile:
commute-bot: Reminder: Redwood office opening delayed 1 hour due to local transit issues.
Priya: anyone bringing coffee for riders? :coffee:
Aaron: I'll pick up a 4-pack — who wants what?
Jae: black for me. Thanks!
Maya: oatmilk latte for me please.
Aaron: noted. see you at 8:10/8:30. Stay dry everyone. (reaction :umbrella_with_rain_drops: by Priya)
